name: Pipe organ
description: The front of a church organ in a dim stone hall: thirty-three pipes in towers and flats, each a part of the spectrum, the longest the lowest. When its part sounds a pipe's mouth glows and the standing wave shows up its length. The keys of two keyboards go down with their notes, stop knobs draw as their parts sound, a gilt sun over the middle tower spreads its rays with the bass, and dust glints in a shaft of light with the high notes.
